en.hintCordisMixed: plugins that import cordis at runtime must share one copy and one version
en.hintInstall: run dsh plugin install in that profile
en.hintNoProfile: no profile under {root} lists this plugin
en.hintReinstall: reinstall this plugin: its published files are incomplete
en.hintServiceVersion: a service bundle older or newer than the running CLI is a common cause of failed plugin startups

en.shutdownBody: This stops the dsh web process serving this page (PID {pid}) and will not start it again. The page stops working until you run `dsh web` in a terminal.
en.shutdownTitle: Shut down the dsh web service?
en.trendEmpty: Fewer than two days in range — switch to By month or All for a trend
